pattern_explanation: Both languages borrowed these words from the same Latin roots, so the spellings stayed close. Over time their meanings drifted apart, so the lookalike English word is not a reliable translation.
false_friend_warning: Each Spanish word looks almost identical to an English word, but the meanings differ: the Spanish words mean occasionally, to carry out, sensitive and currently. Translating them literally into the English lookalikes, especially when hedging or expressing stance, can change the meaning of a sentence.
